decision: Retain the one-shot legacy replay suppression through the existing authenticated same-field reducer Transfer, independently of exact-V2 snapshot handoff metadata.
reason: Native KDE decoder-v1 trace shows Latin replay followed by Space autocorrection restoring Russian. Removing premature handoff consumption passed the helper regression, but native replay-suppression-v2 still failed: install_context_activation(Transfer) independently discarded LegacyReplayV1. A real factory/bridge/FocusOut/Disable/FocusIn/marker regression reproduces that second loss. Native activation-transfer-v3 still failed because the real opaque terminal delegates DaemonWordBuffer (status 2) and never prepares exact-V2 snapshot metadata. The revised regression exercises both actual bridge dispositions with capabilities 9 and 41; requiring the exact-V2 guard reproduces the capability-9 loss.

Full process-isolated replay-daemon-isolated-v4/SUMMARY.json: 922/922 PASS, 106.892 seconds. Native installed-v3 remains 1 PASS / 2 FAIL; revised v4 native pending. not_tested: Changed-byte native terminal behavior, final browser matrix, visual prefix styling and final release gates are not established by the source regression.

consequences.owner: Existing LayIbusEngine, Shared handoff and suppression state; retain the existing bridge admission and deadline. No new handoff, timer, queue, client exception or output route.
consequences.scope: Preserve LegacyReplayV1 only inside an existing authenticated Transfer whose source owner/path and source tail epoch match shared state. Do not require exact-V2 snapshot handoff fields for the V1 daemon-buffer replay. SourceFree/ResetUnknown, mismatched source/epoch and field changes retain existing fail-closed retirement; one-shot consumption remains unchanged. Exact-V2 handoff preservation and deadline rules are unchanged.
consequences.rollback: Revert this isolated change and its regression while preserving decoder, X11 isolation and transport repairs. No data migration or local runtime replacement.
